name: 500 Rummy
description: 500 Rummy: first to 500 points wins. Melds (sets and runs) score positive; unmelded cards in hand count negative. Key twist: you may draw any card from the discard pile but must take all cards above it and meld the drawn card immediately. 2-8 players; 52 cards plus 2 jokers.

American rummy variant; first to 500 points wins. Key rule: may draw any card from discard pile but must take all cards above it and meld the drawn card immediately.
Seven cards each (2 players) down to five (5+ players); rest stock; one discard pile.

items.text: Dealer's Gambit: A 500 Rum variant that uses a special dealer's joker with nominated effects such as wild card, doubling a meld, or splitting the discard pile.
Partnership 500 Rum: Four-player partnership version where partners sit opposite, may play off on each other's melds, and scores are tracked and win at 500 as a team.
Persian Rummy: A higher-joker variant of 500 Rum using four jokers, where jokers form high-value melds of their own and scoring is adjusted across two deals.
